**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Tighter financial conditions: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.33% | 1M: -5.38%) ↓ falling implying higher yields, while investment grade (LQD BELOW TREND) and high yield (HYG BELOW TREND) show widening pressure.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech showing relative strength but not confirmed by breadth: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +5.08%) ABOVE TREND while Financials weakening with XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -7.14%) BELOW TREND — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US softening: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -0.33%) BELOW TREND; EM and China lag: EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -0.34%) BELOW TREND, FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -0.99% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND. QQQ in CORRECTION (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +3.32%) — short-term pullback inside a stronger month.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Crypto ETF IBIT in CORRECTION (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +5.98%) and ARKK in CORRECTION (1W: -0.75% | 1M: +4.13%) point to selective speculative interest; small caps lag with IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.43% | 1M: -5.21%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Oil and broad commodities show divergent signals: BNO in CORRECTION (1W: -0.45% | 1M: +13.72%) CORRECTION while copper CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -0.55%) BELOW TREND; gold GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy soft: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -1.39% | 1M: -3.27%) BELOW TREND and nat gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND — sector weakness broadly visible.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLK and MTUM ABOVE TREND (XLK 1W: +0.21% | 1M: +5.08%; MTUM 1W: +0.12% | 1M: +5.87%) show momentum leadership. DIVERGENCE: Major divergence across core ETFs (SPY BELOW TREND, XLK ABOVE TREND, XLF BELOW TREND, TLT BELOW TREND) — signals mixed and suppress strong directional calls.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Given NEUTRAL regime and zero breadth, favor selective exposure to momentum/tech ETFs (XLK ABOVE TREND) while monitoring credit and rates stress; reduce exposure to weak cyclicals/financials (XLF BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology — XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +5.08%) if QQQ stabilizes. BEARISH: Financials and Materials — XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -7.14%), XME BELOW TREND (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -12.27%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Brent/energy cyclical bounce — BNO CORRECTION (1W: -0.45% | 1M: +13.72%). BEARISH: Precious metals and industrial commodities — GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -6.75%), SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -6.28% | 1M: -9.35%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: +0.69% | 1M: -2.17%) key watch at ~20 for complacency; HYG/LQD (HYG 1W: -1.14% | 1M: -2.73%; LQD 1W: -1.65% | 1M: -3.39%) watch ratio near historical stress bands; XLK/XLF divergence (XLK 1W: +0.21% | 1M: +5.08% vs XLF 1W: -2.09% | 1M: -7.14%) is the growth/value pivot to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive. XLK and momentum ETFs showing relative strength (XLK ABOVE TREND 1W: +0.21% | 1M: +5.08%), while financials and broad cyclicals are weak (XLF BELOW TREND 1W: -2.09% | 1M: -7.14%). Key risk is the major divergence between tech leadership and pervasive sector weakness—monitor credit (HYG/LQD) and rates (TLT) for resolution.
